question: The p-nitrobenzoic acid is:

options.opc: More acid than benzoic acid and with lower pKa.
options.opd: More acid than benzoic acid and with higher pKa.
options.ope: Less acid than p-methoxybenzoic acid and with lower pKa.

analysis: p-nitrobenzoic acid is more acidic than benzoic acid due to the presence of the nitro group which is electron-withdrawing, leading to increased acidity. The pKa of p-nitrobenzoic acid is lower than that of benzoic acid.
